## Description

Soundcolumn SC series tall boy type speaker system.Two 15cm cone type woofers are installed in the lower range.These two units are mounted above and below the center of the enclosure.It has a 9cm cone mid-range in the middle range and a 2.5cm dome tweeter in the high range.The tweeter unit is the same as the BNS professional speaker.The enclosure has a unique 3-chamber configuration that prevents Woofer back-pressure from affecting the midrange.The exterior is designed to cover 4sides with seamless Saran.Silver cable (van den Hul CS12) is used for internal wiring.Anti-resonance spike was sold separately.
